html:
SMTO-CTX-0027 — An attached file is too large for the AI model to read in full

GUID: e87c3c2a-6bb3-4a01-adcd-cfd8cdc296d0
Slug: context-full-read-exceeds-model-budget
Domain: CTX · Subsystem: ctx

What happened

  • SMTO is set to give the AI model whole attached files at once. This file, plus everything the task already holds, is bigger than the model's space, so none of it was given to the model.

How to fix — simple steps

  1. Open Settings › Agent behavior › Context & Attachments and turn off Read full attached context. With it off, SMTO reads the file in pieces that each fit in the model's space.
  2. In the same place, check that Maximum characters per Context read is a modest number, such as the default 12000, not a very large one. This number sets the size of each piece once full reading is off.
  3. Start a new task for the remaining work and attach the file again. The current task keeps the reading setting it started with, so only a new task uses your change.
  4. If you need the whole file in one go, ask the person who manages SMTO to use a model with more space in Settings › Setup › Model routing. Only a model with a bigger space can hold this entire file at once.

What success looks like

  • The new task reads the file piece by piece and keeps going without this message.

If it still fails

  • Select Copy error details and send them to the person who manages SMTO; they show the file's size and the space that was left. Don't cut text out of your earlier messages or rerun earlier steps to make room.

Technical details

Observed condition

  • Full-read context policy required the entire remaining attached source, but admission found that the complete text plus preserved request state and reserved output exceeds the model context window; no source text was delivered.

What this means

  • Full-read policy requires the entire selected source, but admission finds that complete text plus retained request state and reserved output cannot fit. Context admission, storage and reading are separate from executing a tool mutation. Preserve existing task state and receipts; a context diagnostic does not authorize replay of earlier operations.

Why this can happen

  • Full-read policy requires the entire selected source, but admission finds that complete text plus retained request state and reserved output cannot fit.

How to diagnose it

  • Compare the captured full-read policy, complete source size and remaining request capacity; a smaller page requires a task policy that permits bounded reading.

How to fix it

  • For a new task, turn off Read full attached context in Settings > Agent behavior > Context & Attachments so read_context uses bounded pages (Maximum characters per Context read), or route to a model with more verified capacity in Settings > Setup > Model routing. The active run keeps its captured read policy and model profile; repeating the same full read cannot fit, and raising timeouts or replaying completed operations does not help.
  • Turn off Read full attached context for a new task and use a smaller bounded read. If necessary, choose a model with sufficient verified capacity for a new task. The active task retains its captured read policy and model configuration.

Retry and execution caution

  • Repeating the same read without reducing its size or changing the task capacity cannot make it fit. No source text was delivered.

How to verify the fix

  • A new task's supported read policy and selected source fit the complete model request without truncating protected input.

What not to do

  • Do not increase a timeout or replay completed operations to address a token-capacity failure.
  • Do not delete retained receipts or truncate protected input to make the read fit.

Technical notes

  • Context admission, storage and reading are separate from executing a tool mutation. Preserve existing task state and receipts; a context diagnostic does not authorize replay of earlier operations.
  • Preserve the occurrence ID and safe request/operation references. Receipts and occurrence facts establish what started or completed; the catalog does not authorize retries or establish execution outcome.

Do not confuse with / related errors

  • SMTO-CTX-0026 — This part of an attached file is too large for the AI model
  • SMTO-CTX-0002 — A step's results were too large to send to the model
